# Sewa Subidha Gardening
> Garden design, landscaping, and maintenance for homes and commercial spaces across Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, and surrounding areas of Nepal.

## Business
- Brand: Sewa Subidha Gardening
- Founded: 2009
- Studio location: Godawari -7, Lalitpur, Nepal
- Service area: Kathmandu Valley and select projects in Pokhara and Chitwan
- Phone: +977 9851-206373
- Email: hello@sewasubidagardening.com
- Hours: Sunday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Team: 28 specialists across garden design, horticulture, masonry, irrigation, and maintenance

## Why customers choose us
1. We design gardens for Nepal's climate, using drought-resistant plants and practical layouts.
2. We offer full-service landscaping, from concept design and installation to maintenance plans.
3. We provide transparent, itemised quotations and clear communication from site visit to handover.

## Services
- Garden Design & Landscaping
- Lawn Installation
- Plant Selection & Planting
- Event & Wedding Decor
- Routine Maintenance
- Irrigation & Sprinkler Setup
- Tree Surgery & Pruning
- Rainwater Harvesting
- Container Gardening

## Common questions
- Q: How long does a garden project take? A: Residential projects typically take 3 to 14 days depending on scope.
- Q: Do you provide free quotes? A: Yes. We offer a free site consultation and a written quote before work begins.
- Q: Do you work outside Kathmandu? A: Yes, we serve Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Madhyapur Thimi, and select projects beyond the Valley.
- Q: Are you available for maintenance? A: Yes. We offer weekly, fortnightly, and monthly maintenance plans.
